# Personal journal mood chart layout

Static layout proofs for the flagged mood chart and export. Scores are synthetic.
These images are not an authenticated journal session.

- `mood-390.png` is a 390 CSS pixel width at 2x.
- `mood-1440.png` is a 1440 CSS pixel width at 2x.

The chart and export render only when `ENABLE_JOURNAL_MOOD_TRACKING` is on and the signed-in account has a confirmed `@tuturuuu.com` email.
